summary: Frontend-only responsive verification of /admin shell on mobile (390x844), tablet (820x1180), and desktop (1280x800). All 11 acceptance criteria verified. Drawer pattern, hamburger button, persistent sidebar at lg+, Signed-in card, all 12 nav items across 4 sections, auto-close on route change, no page-level horizontal overflow on Leads/Tasks/Customers/ClaimsQueue/Settings, all tables horizontally scrollable inside overflow-x-auto with all columns visible (Leads=11, Tasks=8, Customers=6, ClaimsQueue=6 th cells, none display:none), Add Lead form contains all 18 required fields. Fixed one minor mobile-responsive bug on Settings (long webhook <code> URL was overflowing 47px) by adding break-all class.

issues: FIXED: long webhook URL inside <code> tag was extending 47px past viewport causing whole page to scroll horizontally. Added 'break-all' class to allow wrapping. Verified post-fix: documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.jsx is solid: drawer pattern with translate-x transition, body scroll-lock when open, route-change auto-close, dual sidebar (hidden lg:flex desktop + lg:hidden fixed drawer) all correct. data-testid coverage on admin-drawer-open / admin-sidebar-drawer / admin-sidebar / admin-signed-in / admin-mobile-logout / admin-drawer-backdrop / admin-drawer-close / admin-nav-* / admin-logout-btn is comprehensive.

Tables on Leads/Tasks/Customers/ClaimsQueue correctly use overflow-x-auto wrapper + min-w-[…] approach so all columns stay in DOM (zero hidden th). Confirmed via getComputedStyle: none of the th have display:none on mobile. This satisfies the user's 'don't reduce the fields' requirement.
Settings.jsx had one missed mobile case (long webhook URL); now fixed. Other long display strings inside the page (Stripe webhook secret, masked keys) already wrap or use truncate appropriately.

Minor: at the Add Lead slide-in panel on mobile, the panel itself is wider than the 390px viewport (it slides in occupying ~448px) so users must horizontally pan to see the left edge of fields. Not a blocker (form is fully usable, no fields lost) but if a tighter mobile experience is desired the panel could use w-full sm:w-[480px] (or similar) instead of a fixed >390px width. Reporting only — not in scope of this PR's acceptance criteria.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin responsive layout verified across mobile/tablet/desktop. Drawer breakpoint is lg (1024px): below lg shows hamburger + slide-in drawer, at/above lg shows persistent .lux-sidebar + .lux-signed-in card. All admin tables use overflow-x-auto + min-w-[NNNpx] pattern with zero hidden columns to honor user's 'don't reduce the fields' requirement. Add Lead form on /admin/leads renders all 18 fields (Customer Name, Country, State, City, Postcode, Company Size, Full Address, Website, PIC Name, Job Title, IC Number, Passport Number, Mobile Number, Office Number, Fax Number, Email, Pipeline Status, Source). Fixed one missed mobile responsive issue in Settings.jsx (webhook <code> needed break-all).
